description: fallbackLocale and instanceLocale are both spelled hy-810 - a tag that is on disk under NEITHER of its two loaded equivalents. DefaultStrings must canonicalize the configured fallback locale, find it equivalent to both hy-AM and hy-SU, and break the tie from the tiebreaker list (DefaultStrings.java:446-470), whose first entry here is hy-AM. Identical files and identical cases to locale-identity-deprecated-fallback-locale-reordered; only the tiebreaker ORDER differs.
